chunks: And from him, from Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Process your brides at night and feed [the guests] at dawn."

key_terms.زُفُّوا: Process or escort (specifically the bride to the groom's home)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended time for the wedding procession and feast in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) prescribes these timings to balance communal joy with practical hospitality, as evening processions allow for larger gatherings while the forenoon meal ensures guests are served at their peak appetite. This guidance reflects the Shia emphasis on integrating social etiquette with spiritual modesty, distinguishing the public celebration from the private sanctity of the marital union.
